content.text: At 8 night waking is less typical than at younger ages — her brain is active enough that stress, anxiety about school or friends, or a too-stimulating wind-down can pull her out of sleep in the early hours. A strict screen cutoff an hour before bed and a short predictable routine (book, dim lights, same time every night) is the most common thing families try first.
